title: UAV Video Deblurring via Motion-Aware Diffusion: A Path to Robust Target Detection
abstract: arXiv:2608.15259v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) play a crucial role in various scenarios ranging from disaster response to traffic surveillance. However, aerial video footage often suffers from severe motion blur due to rapid flight maneuvers, vibrations, and camera panning, which can significantly degrade downstream tasks such as target detection. Our goal is to explore a computationally-efficient and effective video deblurring approach to enhance UAV target detection performance. To reduce computational cost, we first propose an Adaptive Latent Scale Selector that dynamically adjusts the latent space resolution according to the intensity of UAV motion, thus balancing detail preservation with inference efficiency. translated_title: 基于运动感知扩散的无人机视频去模糊：通往稳健目标检测的路径
translated_abstract: 无人机在从灾害响应到交通监控的各种场景中扮演着关键角色。然而，由于快速飞行机动、振动和相机平移，航拍视频经常遭受严重的运动模糊，这会显著降低目标检测等下游任务的性能。我们的目标是探索一种计算高效且有效的视频去模糊方法，以提升无人机目标检测性能。为降低计算成本，我们首先提出一种自适应潜尺度选择器，根据无人机运动强度动态调整潜空间分辨率，从而在细节保留与推理效率之间取得平衡。为确保时间一致性，我们引入一个多帧对齐与可学习门控模块，用于对前序帧进行扭曲和门控，使模型仅融合相关的时间信息，并抑制错位或无信息的内容。
tldr: 本文提出一种计算高效的运动感知扩散视频去模糊方法，通过自适应潜尺度选择和可学习门控，显著提升无人机目标检测的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a computationally efficient motion-aware diffusion video deblurring method that enhances UAV target detection robustness via adaptive latent scale selection and learnable gating.
